von-thunen-rings.alt: Concentric rings around a market town M on a flat plain. Ring 1, nearest the market: market gardening and dairy. Ring 2: forest, for fuel and lumber. Ring 3: grain and field crops. Ring 4: livestock ranching. Beyond ring 4 is wilderness.

von-thunen-river.alt: A drawn map of an invented region. Zones of land use surround a market town in stretched ovals that are much longer east to west, along a river, than north to south. Zones are lettered from the town outward: W nearest the town, then X, Y and Z. Area V, in the far corner, lies outside all the zones. A small town in the southeast has its own small zone the same color as zone W around it.
